lt:n3:017.problem: The kanji gate passes at N3 and the key is sound: only ベランダの花 is done 'まず'. The bath water waits until after tonight's bath, the bike is already at the parents' house, and the flashlights are sold out. The problem is the word dimension. かいちゅうでんとう (懐中電灯) has no corpus record, so no lesson teaches it. Writing it in kana only hides it from the kanji gate, and SudachiPy splits it into かい/ちゅう/で/ん/とう, so the word check misses it too. That leaves an untaught, hard-to-parse word in the script and in a printed distractor (かいちゅうでんとうを買いに行く). かんりにん (管理人, no corpus record) has the same kind of problem: the hiragana run とかんりにんの gets split into かん/り/に/ん. Fix: 大家さん (vocab:1413140 おおや, taught, kanji taught, SudachiPy reads オオヤサン) replaces the manager. パン (taught) replaces the flashlight, with a food reason (台風の間は買い物に行けない), and keeps the same sold-out distractor role. Key, family and the other distractors are unchanged. The corrected version has 0 untaught kanji and 0 untaught corpus words.
